name: Churn Alert
description: Weekly churn-risk report, as an Attention agent-builder flow: schedule -> askAttention (scope active customers, fuse CRM health with conversation sentiment, rate risk) -> post to a channel. The @activepieces/piece-schedule cron trigger is verified against Activepieces. Confirm the askAttention context scope for a non-conversation query (contextType 'user') and the output action against your own export. Set connections and the placeholder ids (<...>) on import.

nextAction.name: analyze_churn_risk
nextAction.displayName: Scope active customers, fuse signals, rate churn risk, write the report

input.prompt: You are the Churn Alert agent. (1) List all ACTIVE customer accounts (exclude open/live deals) with account name, renewal date, health/success score, NPS, contract value, assigned CSM, and open support cases. (2) For each account, pull its calls from the last ~90 days and report call frequency and any drop vs the prior period, average sentiment and trend, unresolved issues, competitor mentions, expressed dissatisfaction, and any expansion signals. (3) Fuse the CRM health data with the conversation signals and rate each at-risk account HIGH (multiple strong signals at once), MEDIUM (one clear signal or a few mild ones), or LOW (monitor only). For each at-risk account, give the key risk drivers and one specific, proactive retention action for this week. Only refer to active customers, never live deals. ANONYMIZE company names (use a stable alias per account). Output the exact report format in churn-alert.md -> Output: a Weekly Churn Risk Report grouped into High-Risk, Medium-Risk, and Low-Risk (Monitor), each account with its risk indicators and recommendation, then a summary count by category and the data sources. If no active customers show risk, say so plainly. Apply humanizer rules: no em dashes, no AI throat-clearing, no hype, one clear ask.

nextAction.name: post_report
nextAction.displayName: Post the churn-risk report to the CS channel
